text:
sasha: heads up — after the 12:15 deploy I’m seeing a sustained p99 latency bump (~15%) for short-seq workloads. traces show a bunch of compilation stalls. :eyes:
ci-bot: PERF ALERT: nightly/perf/regression detected. Metric: runtime/p99_tokens (+14.8%). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/3321
morgan: any obvious culprit in the release notes? which merge?
sasha: rollout included PR#7812 (kernel-autopick refactor) and PR#7820 (kv-cache eviction tweak). suspect either one.
raj: starting a bisect across commits between deploy_base..HEAD. will run perf job locally and report.
nana: @raj fyi the canary showed compile queue length spikes at ~12:16 and ~12:20, matches the deploy window.
raj: ok quick findings: reverting 7812 removes the compile spikes entirely. with 7812 reverted, p99 back to baseline. with 7820 reverted but 7812 present, spikes remain. preliminary: 7812 likely root.
anna: do we have kernel-selection logs that show which heuristic changed?
nana: here's snippet from the runtime debug log around a spike:
```
[12:16:08] kernel_autopick: selected kernel=matmul_v2_autotune pick_score=0.31 fallback_score=0.29
[12:16:08] compile_queue: enqueue kernel=matmul_v2_autotune model_id=llm-1 seq=16
[12:16:09] kvcache: miss rate 0.43 -> 0.67 (evictions=124)
[12:16:10] compile_storm: concurrent_compiles=18 (threshold=8)
```
ana: notice pick_score difference tiny; new heuristic flipped preference to a kernel that triggers longer compile time and higher memory working set, causing KV cache churn.
kevin: that matches what I saw in perf profiles: the chosen kernel has a large JIT footprint and causes memory pressure during compile, evicting KV cache pages and forcing recompute of prefixes.
sasha: interesting — so not a straight kernel perf regression, but an autotune/heuristic change that increases cold-compile tail and indirectly hurts latency via kvcache churn.
raj: bisect notes attached (short):
```
commit abc123 (before): p99 120ms
commit def456 (with 7812): p99 138ms (+15%) compile_queue median compile_ms 42 -> 180
commit ghi789 (with only 7820): p99 122ms
```
raj: recommend revert 7812 from prod ASAP or patch the heuristic to add a stronger cost for compile-time.
kevin: quick mitigation: lower max_concurrent_compiles to 6 on canaries and increase compile caching TTL to 120s. That reduces compile_storm frequency while we patch.
infra-oncall: applied hotfix (max_concurrent_compiles=6) to canary pool at 12:48. monitoring.
ci-bot: ci/perf re-run queued for the reverted branch.
sasha: after hotfix canary p99 dropped back ~8% toward baseline, still a small residual. we should schedule a short rollback of 7812 if patch won't land in <24h.
morgan: can we add a guard: if pick_score advantage < 0.05, prefer kernel with lower compile_time_est? cheap heuristic to avoid these flips.
nana: agreed — will propose fix: incorporate compile_time_est * compile_penalty into score, and bump cache TTLs.
kevin: also add a metric: kernel_autopick.choice_delta to perf dashboards so small-score flips are visible during rollouts.
raj: I’ll open an emergency PR with the heuristic patch + test sim for pick stability. tagging @morgan @ana for review.
sasha: thanks all — leaving rollout blocked until either revert is fully rolled or patch merged + validated on canary. :thumbsup:
